verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's own docs describe a first-party MCP endpoint that coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Zed) connect to over OAuth 2.1 with no API keys. It exposes tools to list services, run SQL, and read monitoring, which directly delivers the story. The evidence is a single summary-level doc entry, so missing for 10: in-depth setup and tool-reference documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described.
